_README: Cross-language golden for the value-free SCREEN label (ADR-0024 §6a/§6b). Each [input, expected] pair must hold for BOTH normalization/step_suggest.screen_label (Python) and viewer/process-map-levels.screenType (JS), which share screen-label-patterns.json. The two engines can silently diverge (Python re.sub replaces ALL matches, JS String.replace replaces only the FIRST without a /g flag; regex dialects and the end-trim differ), so this fixture pins their agreement -- if they drift, one logical screen splits into a per-record node and the screen-grain map fans out. Tested by normalization/test/test_screen_label.py and viewer/process-map-levels.test.js. The sibling of process-label-golden.json.
